categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in education technology, professional audio-visual products, video conferencing systems, smart health, OEM/ODM manufacturing services, and smart agriculture. Key product lines include document cameras, tablet charging carts, PTZ cameras, auto-tracking cameras, and integrated video conferencing solutions. The company also develops AI-enabled products and solutions for remote healthcare and smart agriculture applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include video, audio, optics, AI, and integrated hardware-software development. The company emphasizes AI-driven features such as voice tracking, smart framing, noise suppression, and gesture control. Manufacturing incorporates automated production lines with AI-enhanced processes and strict environmental and quality management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are educational institutions (K-12 and higher education), enterprises requiring video conferencing, government agencies, healthcare providers for telemedicine, and OEM/ODM clients in Europe, America, and Asia. The company serves over 100 countries globally, focusing on education, corporate, government, and professional AV markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global presence with sales and service offices in the United States, Europe (Germany, UK, France, Netherlands, Spain), Japan, Korea, Thailand, Russia, China, and Vietnam. Its products are marketed and sold in over 100 countries worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment as a developer and manufacturer of video and audio equipment, integrating hardware and software solutions. It also provides OEM/ODM design and manufacturing services, positioning itself as a key supplier to global brands and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening AI integration in video and audio products, expanding system integration capabilities, and developing new applications in smart health and smart agriculture. The company invests over 18% of revenue in R&D, focusing on AI algorithms, multi-camera systems, cloud management software, and energy-efficient product design. It aims to enhance user experience, product quality, and ecosystem partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of proprietary branded hardware and software solutions, including document cameras, video conferencing systems, and charging carts. Additional revenue streams come from OEM/ODM manufacturing contracts and value-added software services such as device management platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include Logitech, HP Poly, Yealink, MaxHub, Neat, and Crestron. The company positions itself as a leading Taiwanese brand with strong R&D, AI integration, and global market reach. It competes by offering high-quality, innovative, and integrated solutions with strong customer service and ecosystem partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.61 billion, a 5.04% increase from the previous year. Net profit after tax was NT$189.5 million, with a gross margin near 60%. The company maintains a solid financial structure with a 12.21% increase in shareholders' equity and invests heavily in R&D (over 18% of revenue). It has shown steady growth despite global economic uncertainties.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior integration of video, audio, optics, and AI technologies to deliver high-quality, user-friendly, and innovative communication and education solutions. Its products feature advanced AI capabilities such as voice tracking and smart framing, robust build quality, and energy-efficient designs. The company also offers comprehensive ecosystem integration and strong after-sales support, differentiating itself from competitors.
